See also: ObjectsHelp
You see a strong health potion.
It weighs 2.90 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by knights, paladins and monks of level 50 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 250 and 350 Hitpoints, around 300 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Hit Point and Capacity Taken per Hit Point

History

  • Monks gained the ability to consume these potions with the release of the Monk Vocation Update on April 08, 2025.
  • The price was further increased from 100 gp to 115 gp with the Summer 2024 Update on Jul 01, 2024.
  • The price was increased from 80 gp to 100 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Strong Health Potions went from 8 Tibia Coins to 10 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Strong Health Potions went from 18 Tibia Coins to 21 Tibia Coins.
